preconditions.description: Input dimensions must satisfy the given constraints for n (number of fields), m (number of die faces), and k (number of turns).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= n for i in range(1, n + 1)) and all(1 <= f_i <= n for f_i in f)
preconditions.description: Each field index i and its transition f_i must be within the valid range of 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= p_j < M for p_j in p) and sum(p) % M == 1
preconditions.description: Each die face probability p_j must be a non-negative integer less than M, and their sum modulo M must equal 1.
The modulus M is fixed to 998244353.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout_lines) == n and all(0 <= int(line.strip()) < M for line in stdout_lines.splitlines())
postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n lines, each representing a probability modulo M as an integer between 0 and M-1.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= x_i < M for x_i in [int(line.strip()) for line in stdout_lines.splitlines()])
postconditions.description: Each output probability x_i must be a valid integer in the range [0, M).

postconditions.expression: sum(int(line.strip()) for line in stdout_lines.splitlines()) % M == 1
postconditions.description: The sum of all output probabilities modulo M must equal 1, ensuring they represent a valid probability distribution.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= x_i <= 1 for x_i in [int(line.strip()) * pow(M, -1, M) % M for line in stdout_lines.splitlines()])
postconditions.description: Each output probability x_i, when interpreted as a rational number modulo M, must lie in the range [0, 1] (inclusive).
